label: Reflection at a port
subgoals: Terminate every other port in the reference impedance
Compute the reflection coefficient against that reference
Express the magnitude in decibels with twenty log ten

label: Insertion loss in decibels
subgoals: Read S21 as the transmitted wave over the incident wave
Convert the magnitude to decibels with twenty log ten
Convert a power ratio to the same decibels with ten log ten

label: Power balance, passivity and reciprocity
subgoals: Subtract the reflected and transmitted power fractions from one
Require the remainder to be non-negative for a passive network
Check that S21 equals S12 for a reciprocal network
